items.computation: Anchor: Rechnungsdatum 14.04.2026, invoice from a private company (utility), so §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB apply. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the invoice date is not counted, so counting starts 15.04.2026. A 30-day period from 14.04.2026 ends on 14.05.2026 (Thu, Christi Himmelfahrt, a nationwide public holiday). Under § 193 BGB, since the last day is a public holiday, the deadline shifts to the next business day: Friday 15.05.2026.
